body_html:
The Echo medium-back multi-tilter is an ergonomic office chair built to fit the person sitting in it, not the other way around. With a full suite of independent adjustments, it lets each user dial in back angle, lumbar support, seat height and arm position to their own proportions, making it a confident choice for varied workstations, shared desks and growing teams. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group.

Features

  • Independent, infinite-position back angle adjustment with infinite tilt-lock control and tension adjustment
  • Adjustable Schukra lumbar support, adjustable for both height and depth
  • Back and lumbar height and angle adjustment for tailored spinal support
  • Pneumatic seat height adjustment from 17 to 21 inches
  • Forward seat angle adjustment and lock for active sitting postures
  • Height- and width-adjustable arms
  • Durable five-star base on smooth dual-wheel casters

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 26 in wide by 26.5 in deep by 44 in high, with a seat-height range of 17 to 21 in and a 300 lb weight rating for standard single-shift commercial use. The chair pairs a moulded-foam seat and hardwood back shell with fabric upholstery available in a wide range of Global graded textile colours, and is tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964) at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and fabric selection, or call 1-800-835-9565. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and components, 12 years on control mechanisms, with 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.
